# Contract review: the longest a ticket takes

File: `contract.ringi` (the request `contract`, version 1, sha256:ae57995cfb44cd30).

Kept by the team Legal (`legal`).

The organization is read in its version in effect on 2026-11-16: the one from 2026-04-01.

## The longest a ticket takes

A ticket of this request ends within 192 business days at the most:

| What | Business days |
|---|---|
| The longest path of the route, 4 times: once, and again each time it is sent back | 4 × 38 |
| With the requester, to submit it again, 3 times | 3 × 10 |
| Paused | 10 |
| In all | 192 |

## The longest path

Every stage comes, those with a condition too.

| Stage | Who answers | Deadline | When it is late | Business days at the most |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| manager | manager | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 7 |
| summary | a summary the flow `summarize` writes | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 3 |
| intake | legal | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 7 |
| review | reviewer | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 7 |
| second | at least 2 of legal | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 7 |
| counsel | counsel | 3 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 7 |

One round of this path takes 38 business days at the most.

From 2026-04-03 (Fri) to 2026-12-22 (Tue): 187 business days.

> No ticket takes longer than 192 business days, whatever the days the calendar closes; a ticket that takes all of them need not be there. On these dates it takes fewer: where a deadline at the end of a day runs out on the eve of a day the calendar closes, the stage goes up on the closed day, which is not a business day, and so takes one business day less.

## What shortens it

Each row changes one thing of the request, and says what the longest becomes, counted the same way: where another path becomes the longest, it is counted on that path.

| Change | The longest becomes | Shorter by |
|---|---|---|
| Every stage due in 2 business days instead of 3 business days | 148 | 44 |
| Sent back at most 2 times instead of 3 times | 144 | 48 |
| Submitted again within 9 business days instead of 10 business days | 189 | 3 |
| Paused at most 9 business days instead of 10 business days | 191 | 1 |
